title: Interests
content:
To indemnify the {{insured_or_reinsured}} in respect of a Policy or Policies issued by them to the Insured in respect of:

Hull War and Spares and Associated Perils

1. Hull
To cover Aircraft in accordance with the Aircraft Schedule.

2. Spares
Spares (as defined in the Hull All Risk coverage, Spare Parts and Equipment) being owned by the Insured or owned by others for which the Insured irresponsible and has been required to insure them.

AGAINST Loss or damage caused by War and Allied Risks as specified in paragraphs (a) and (c) to (g) of the War Exclusion and Allied Risks (Aviation) Clause AVN48B and in addition confiscation and extortion and hijack expenses.

However, with respect to Aircraft Spare Parts, the coverage provided with respect to hazards as specified in paragraph (a) of Clause AVN 48B shall only apply as long as such property is in transit by air or water, as defined under "Duration" in the CL388 War Institute (Air Freight) Clause and "Duration" in the CL385 Institute (Cargo) Clause.

title: Situation
Reinsurance Conditions
content:
In addition to the terms and conditions set out in the Original Insurance terms, conditions and exclusions, this reinsurance is subject to the following:

Reinsurance Subscription and Claims Control Clause:

This is a reinsurance of the Reinsured and except as provided by paragraph 2 thereof, or as terms may otherwise be stated in this reinsurance, warranted the same coverage terms and conditions as those applying to the Reinsured as agreed at inception.

Subject to the foregoing, it is a condition precedent to any liability under this reinsurance that:

a) No amendment to the terms or conditions or additions to or deletions from the original insurance shall be binding upon reinsurers hereon unless prior agreement has been obtained from the said reinsurers or except as may be otherwise provided for in this reinsurance.

b) The Reinsured shall upon knowledge of any loss which may give rise to a claim under this reinsurance, advise the reinsurers thereof within a period of seven days (inadvertent omission of advice excepted);

c) The Reinsured shall furnish the reinsurers with all information available respecting such loss or losses, and the reinsurers shall have the sole right to appoint adjusters, assessors, surveyors and/or lawyers and to control all negotiations, adjustments and settlements in connection with such loss or losses.

AVN 41A (amended)

Simultaneous Settlement (Reinsurance) Clause LPO 438.

Cancellation Clause as in the Original Policy.

Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999 Exclusion Clause AVN 72.

Sanctions and Embargo Clause AVN 111(R).

Reinsurer Review Clause

Notwithstanding anything in this reinsurance to the contrary, in the event that an individual subscribing reinsurer:

a) is subject to a security downgrade which at any time is below the Lockton approved security standards for Insurers (being ‘BBB’ as rated by S&P, and/or ‘A minus’ as rated by AM Best, and/or unencumbered policyholders' surplus as stipulated in said guidelines), or

b) gives notice that they intend to withdraw from writing business in the aviation reinsurance market, then the reinsured shall have the option to reduce or terminate such reinsurer’s participation, at that time.

Cleaned Text
If such reinsurer is the leading reinsurer the reinsured shall also have the option to change its status to a following reinsurer after selecting a new leading reinsurer.

The change of leader status option by the reinsured may also apply in the event that a leading reinsurer, or their parent company, is subject to a material change being a change of majority ownership or controlling interest. No reduction or termination of the leading reinsurer’s participation shall apply in this event.

Any change of leader shall be agreed by all other reinsurers.

The effective date of any reduction, termination or changed status shall be at the sole discretion of the Reinsured and shall be subject to advice in writing to the reinsurer, issued via Lockton, and shall not be prior to the date on which the reinsured issues such advice.

The premium due to the reinsurer as respects that part of their participation which is terminated shall be the earned premium or pro rata of premium (as applicable) up to the date of reduction or of termination. However, in the event that the incurred claims at the effective date of reduction or termination of a reinsurer’s participation exceed the earned or pro rata premium (as applicable) due to the reinsurer, any return premium shall be subject to mutual agreement.

As used herein, ‘S&P’ refers to ‘Standard & Poor’s Insurance Rating (a division of the McGraw-Hill Companies)’ and ‘AM Best’ refers to ‘A.M. Best Company Inc’ or successors of both.

title: Conditions
content:
Original Insurance per Hull War Policy and Allied Risks LSW555D except as amended herein.

Including confiscation, nationalisation, seizure, restraint, detention, appropriation, requisition for title or use by or under the order of the government(s) of aircraft registry (whether civil, military or de facto) or public or local authority - exclusion (b) of LSW555D deleted.

Cancellation Revision and Automatic Termination provisions per Section Five of LSW 555D amended to provide that automatic termination only applies in respect of War perils (i.e. as paragraph (a) of Section One of LSW 555D).

In the event of cancellation by Insurers or automatic termination in accordance with Provisions 1(c) and 2 of Section Five of LSW 555D a pro rata return of premium shall be payable to the Insured.

Additions to and deletions from the Schedule of Aircraft, substitutions of Aircraft and Agreed Value changes are automatically covered hereunder subject to not exceeding a maximum Agreed Value of 125% of the highest aircraft agreed value as stated in the schedule of aircraft subject always to an overall maximum of {{hw_max_agreed_value}} (or currency equivalent at date of attachment) any one Aircraft, with declaration to Insurers monthly and pro rata premium adjustment at expiry.

Supplementary Payments Clause (AVN76 (amended)) – Provided always that Insurers' liability shall not exceed 15% of the maximum declared aircraft agreed value as detailed under the Schedule of Aircraft any one incident over all paragraphs insured which is included within the aggregate limit applicable to this Insurance and not in addition.

In the event of the Period of Insurance being greater than twelve (12) months the aggregate limit of liability for the total period shall be and shall in no event exceed the annual aggregate limits stated in this Insurance, plus pro rata of such aggregate limits, of which not more than the annual aggregate limit set forth in this Insurance shall be applicable for either (i) the first twelve months, or (ii) for the remainder of the Period of Insurance respectively.

Software Affirmation Clause LMA 5450

Leased Engines Clause
When leased engines / components (other than as covered under this Insurance) are installed on an Aircraft insured hereunder, the agreed value of such Aircraft shall be automatically increased, at pro rata additional premium, by the amount required to be insured under the lease agreement in respect of such engines / components for the period that such engines / components are installed on the Aircraft. Where such amount is not specified in the lease agreement, this shall be the fair market value of such engines / components as agreed between the Insurers and the owners of the engines / components at the time of the loss. A maximum Agreed Value of 125% of the highest aircraft agreed value as stated in the schedule of aircraft subject always to an overall maximum of {{hw_max_agreed_value}} (or currency equivalent at date of attachment) any one Aircraft, with declaration to Insurers monthly and pro rata premium adjustment at expiry.

Benefit of salvage of the removed engine / component to the Insurers in the event that the Aircraft is the subject of a claim adjustable on the basis of a total loss.

Insurers hereon agree to automatically include coverage for contractual provisions including hold harmless agreements, indemnity agreements, waivers of subrogation, additional Insureds, breach of warranty, loss payees, leased spares and equipment agreed values arising in the normal course of the Insured’s business or operations, including all such contractual provisions and evidence of insurance executed prior to the inception of this Insurance. An additional premium of USD 100 is deemed to be charged on each agreement where breach of warranty is required, including in respect of Airline Finance/Lease Contract Endorsement AVN67B/C (Hull War), receipt of which is hereby acknowledged at the inception of this Insurance or subsequent effective date of such agreement.

Other contractual agreements outside the normal course of the Insured’s business or operations are subject to the agreement of the Insurers prior to the effective date of the contract(s).

In the event that the Insured or their employees are rendered by any peril covered by this Insurance unable to protect the Aircraft from damage or wear, tear or gradual deterioration or are prevented from performing any service to any part of the Aircraft made necessary by the passage of time, this Insurance shall cover all costs and expenses necessarily incurred to reinstate the Aircraft to its condition immediately prior to exposure to such perils.

In respect of parts, engines or sub-assemblies detached from any Aircraft for any purpose, including repair or overhaul, and not replaced, coverage provided hereunder shall continue on an Agreed Value basis for full replacement value, including whilst such parts, engines or sub-assemblies are in transit.

title: Several Liability Notice Insurance
content:
The subscribing insurers' obligations under contracts of insurance to which they subscribe are several and not joint and are limited solely to the extent of their individual subscriptions. The subscribing insurers are not responsible for the subscription of any co-subscribing insurer who for any reason does not satisfy all or part of its obligations.
